app.name: FlowGuard Agent
app.description: Workflow-first AI Agent Runtime for multi-device task orchestration

openai_compatible._note: Change baseUrl + apiKeyEnvVar to switch providers. No code changes needed.

planner._note: Used when runtime.plannerMode = 'model'. Change model name to match your provider.

vision._note: TODO: v0.1 config reserved only — vision calls not implemented

imageGeneration._note: TODO: v0.1 config reserved only — image generation calls not implemented

embedding._note: TODO: v0.1 uses keyword search — embedding-based RAG not implemented

rules: Models can only generate plans, they cannot bypass the Runtime to execute actions
If a tool does not return success, the final answer must NOT claim the task is completed
All tool calls must be logged with tool_name, args, result, status, timestamp
